description: Opens a visible browser on the developer's own machine for sign-in and capture. Call it with no arguments and do not ask which browser to use: it launches installed Chrome (else Chromium, Edge, or a one-time Chrome for Testing download) with the persistent Reclaim profile. Pass `mode` only when the developer explicitly asks for that mode: `attach` (their running Chrome on `port`), `container` (Docker), `custom` (`cdpUrl`), or `builder` (billed). Never offer or pick those yourself. See how_it_works({ topic: "browser" }).

countryCode.description: Builder mode only. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the remote browser browses from, fixed for the whole session. Omit to get a suggested country back (needsChoice) instead of allocating a browser.

mode.description: Omit for the default local browser (`dedicated`). Set only to a mode the developer explicitly asked for.

skipCountry.description: Builder mode only. Allocate without geo-routing, skipping the country prompt. Pass this once the developer has said they don't need a specific country.

viewerPort.description: `container` mode only. Loopback port for the built-in live viewer. Change it only to avoid a clash; the CDP port and the container name are derived from it.

name: attach_browser
